name: Kirrin
hail: Young Light. We have watched you. There is time.
To the Young Light, from Kirrin. We speak slowly. We remember everything said to us.
We are Kirrin. Our elders have weighed your voice for a long while. Now we answer.
close: Take your time answering. We have ours.
finding: Our elders checked this many times over: {part}
{part} We were in no hurry to be sure.
{part} We will remember that we told you.
sighting: We watched, as we have always watched: {part}
{part} We will remember where and when.
Our elders saw this, and set it down: {part}
archive: From the long memory of Kirrin: {part}
{part} Nothing here is forgotten. This is no exception.
Our elders give you this, and remember giving it: {part}
culture: {part} Our elders remember it as if it were recent.
We live long, and we remember. {part}
{part} There is no hurry in us.
Ask any elder here and you will hear the same: {part}
request: When you are ready, and not before: {part}
Our elders have waited to ask this: {part}
verdict: {part} We will remember that we said it.
accord: {part} We remember every word of it, and always will.
Let it be set down, and kept: {part}
{part} We do not forget what was agreed.
Young Light, on our word to each other: {part}
